brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to verify Silk Factor’s lot location and authorized release status.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor — reconcile release today. Yesterday’s signed internal waiver covers 26 kg awaiting microbial results. Luke’s approval fields are blank; the document also says released and contains conflicting dates. Actual shipment is unverified. Send internally: Aaron and Evelyn, please confirm lots 1110128/1111128 locations and any shipments, reconcile Luke’s acceptance, test results and waiver dates with Sam today, and document authorized disposition before further release.

ACT NOW 2: Talova — incident reported 11 days ago. Safe-method approval, trial evidence and suspect-unit disposition remain unverified in the available records. Send internally: Sam, Ron and Aaron, please record the safety approver, safe recovery method, trial evidence and suspect-unit disposition today before affected-method reuse or a completion promise.

ACT NOW 3: Roon — November 17 trial is 3 days away. Ecolab’s initial instructions still depend on engineering answers and safe chemistry handling; sample chemicals and pumps are not verified received. Acticire remains scheduled to ship after the trial. Send internally: Michael and Aaron, please reconcile the November 17 trial materials and capper readiness, obtain engineering’s cleaning answers and QA/safety’s approved method, and confirm an achievable trial scope before accepting the date.

next: Recommendation: Resolve Silk Factor’s actual disposition first; do not treat an unsigned client acceptance or pending microbial results as clearance.
